verdict.rationale: Crossmint publishes general fee structure (wallet MAU overages, tiered onramp/offramp/checkout fees) but the evidence explicitly states 'No agent-card- or agent-checkout-specific price is published on the pricing page,' meaning the actual fees for agent-originated transactions (Agent Cards, Agent Checkouts) are not disclosed and would require contacting sales. missing for 10: published per-transaction fee for agent cards, published fee for agent checkouts, confirmation that chargeback/dispute coverage terms apply identically to agent flows.
